scripts.build:contracts: npm run generate && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && node tools/build.mjs
scripts.build:local: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @better-loop/privacy && npm run build --workspace @better-loop/measurement && node tools/build-local.mjs
scripts.check:seed: python3 tools/validate_context.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:measurement && npm run check:seed && npm run test:parity && npm run check:artifact
scripts.pack:contracts: npm run build:contracts && npm pack --workspace @better-loop/contracts --pack-destination artifacts
